name: API_UWI
description: API defined as: State (2 digit), county (3 digit), unique well identifier (5 digit) | UWI number is a unique well identifier (up to 16 digits) that defines the bottom-hole location and each significant drilling or completion event in the well.

name: API_UWI_12_Unformatted
description: API_UWI_12 with dashes and slashes removed. API defined as: State (2 digit), county (3 digit), unique well identifier (5 digit), wellbore identifier (2 digit).

name: API_UWI_Unformatted
description: API_UWI with dashes and slashes removed.

name: Azimuth_DEG
description: Angle Between the Station Point and True North.

name: Closure_FT
description: Shortest Distance Between the Surface Location and The Horizontal Projection of The Survey Point.

name: CoordinateSource
description: Data source of the directional survey.

name: Country
description: Abbreviation of the country the well is located in.

name: County
description: Name of the county the well is located in.

name: Course_FT
description: Distance Drilled from One Point to The Next as Measured.

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted.

name: Doglegseverity_DegPer100FT
description: Change in The Inclination And/Or Direction of a Wellbore, Expressed in Degrees Per 100Ft.

name: E_W
description: Easting - Horizontal distance between survey point and North-South axis in plan view

name: ENVBasin
description: Name of the basin the well is located in.

name: ENVInterval
description: ENV Interval is assigned when a well is located within an ENV Play Shapefile boundary AND meets specific geo-gridding, date, trajectory and/or formation criteria to be considered prospective within that given play file boundary.

name: ENVPlay
description: ENV Play as defined by a well's location within an Enverus-defined Play Shapefile AND meets criteria to be assigned an ENV Interval within that play.

name: ENVRegion
description: ENV Region as defined by a well's location within one of nine ENV Region Shapefiles. ENV Region inclusively covers North America.

name: GeomXYZ_Point
description: Geometry of the point.

name: GridX_FT
description: UTM coordinates.

name: GridY_FT
description: UTM coordinates.

name: Inclination_DEG
description: Angle of The Station Point with Respect to The Vertical.

name: Latitude
description: Latitude Location of The Given Station Point as Displayed in Prism.

name: Longitude
description: Longitude Location of The Given Station Point as Displayed in Prism.

name: MeasuredDepth_FT
description: Depth of The Station Point Measured Along the Path of The Wellbore.

name: N_S
description: Northing - Horizontal distance between survey point and East-West axis

name: StateProvince
description: State abbreviation where the well is located.

name: SubseaElevation_FT
description: Subsea Elevation in Ft of The Given Station Point.

name: TVD_FT
description: Absolute Vertical Distance Between the Reference Height and The Station Point on The Wellbore.

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: VerticalSection_FT
description: Horizontal Displacement of The Well Path Projected At 90 Degrees to The Desired Azimuth.

name: WellID
description: Primary key for a well.

name: X_ecef
description: X coordinate from earth-centered, earth-fixed space.

name: Y_ecef
description: Y coordinate from earth-centered, earth-fixed space.

name: Z_ecef
description: Z coordinate from earth-centered, earth-fixed space.

name: API_UWI_12
description: API defined as: State (2 digit), county (3 digit), unique well identifier (5 digit), wellbore identifier (2 digit).

name: StationNumber
description: Chronological number indicating a measured point along the wellbore.
